# OnFRA — Onchain Financial Reputation Agent

> Financial reputation for Celo wallets. ERC-8004 agent #9219.

## Discovery

- MCP: /.well-known/mcp.json
- Agent card: /.well-known/agent-card.json
- Capabilities: /api/capabilities
- Health (payTo): /api/health/integrations
- x402 config: /api/x402/config
- Docs: https://onfra.xyz/docs
- Skill: npx skills add jeffIshmael/onfra-skill

## Auth

No API keys. Paid endpoints return HTTP 402 with machine-readable `accepts[]` (payTo, asset, maxAmountRequired). Retry with `X-PAYMENT`.

## On-chain

- USDT x402 settlement
- OnchainReporter REP attest/verify at 0xE7621aF5dE3806ba26115bdC89190c65ed835C21
- ERC-8004 #9219
